# Setup steps

A setup flow is a small state machine inside the plugin (`impl SetupFlow`). It never draws anything: it returns **steps as data**, and the web wizard, `swifty plugin add` and any later app draw the same steps and send back the same inputs. The hub keeps the flow in memory, one per person setting up, and applies the result.

```text
hub                                   your SetupFlow
begin(ctx, existing config or None) -> first step
advance(ctx, input)                 -> next step      (repeated)
...                                 -> done(result) or failed
hub: validate result.config, store config, secrets and devices, audit slot names
```

`SetupContext::grant` is `None` in dry-run: a step that needs the network then returns `failed` with a sentence saying live mode is needed, and a flow made only of forms still works. With a grant, end by reading each chosen device once and fail with a helpful reason if that read fails.

## `SetupContext`

What a setup flow may use.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `instance_id` | `String` | The id of the instance being set up. |
| `grant` | `Option<net::LiveGrant>` | `None` in dry-run. A flow that needs the network then returns `Failed` with a sentence saying live mode is needed. A form-only flow still works. |
| `timeouts` | `net::Timeouts` | How long to wait to connect and for each reply. |
| `secrets_present` | `BTreeSet<String>` | Which secret slots already hold a value, for "leave empty to keep". |

## `SetupStep`

One step of a setup flow, for the person to see.

The variant is in `step`.

### form

`SetupStep::Form`. Ask for values.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | The step's heading. |
| `text` | `String` | What to do, in a sentence or two. |
| `fields` | `Vec<Field>` | The fields to fill in. |

**Drawn:** The web wizard shows the title, the text and one input per field, in order, each with its label and help. `swifty plugin add` asks for each field in turn and offers the prefill as the default; a `secret` field is read without echo.

**Answered with:** `values`, with one entry per field key. `back` goes back.

```json
{
  "step": "form",
  "title": "Where is the hub?",
  "text": "Its address on your network, and the port it listens on.",
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "address",
      "label": "Address",
      "help": "Its IP address, such as 192.0.2.20.",
      "kind": {
        "type": "host"
      },
      "required": true,
      "value": null
    },
    {
      "key": "port",
      "label": "Port",
      "help": "Leave it as it is unless you changed it.",
      "kind": {
        "type": "port"
      },
      "required": false,
      "value": 8080
    }
  ]
}
```

### wait

`SetupStep::Wait`. Tell the person to do something physical and wait for it ("Press the button on the bridge", "Accept the prompt on the TV").

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | The step's heading. |
| `text` | `String` | What to do, in a sentence or two. |
| `poll_ms` | `u32` | How often the hub polls the flow, in milliseconds. |
| `timeout_s` | `u32` | How long the hub waits before it gives up, in seconds. |

**Drawn:** The title and the text, with a countdown of `timeout_s`. Nobody types anything: the hub sends `poll` every `poll_ms` until the flow returns another step, and gives up after `timeout_s`.

**Answered with:** `poll`, sent by the hub. `back` when the person gives up.

```json
{
  "step": "wait",
  "title": "Press the button on the hub",
  "text": "Press the round button on top of the hub once. This page goes on by itself.",
  "poll_ms": 2000,
  "timeout_s": 90
}
```

### choose

`SetupStep::Choose`. Pick from what was found (bridges, lights, units, VMs).

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | The step's heading. |
| `text` | `String` | What to do, in a sentence or two. |
| `options` | `Vec<Choice>` | What can be picked. |
| `multiple` | `bool` | Whether more than one can be picked. |
| `min` | `u32` | How many must be picked at least. |

**Drawn:** The title, the text and the options, with `detail` under each label: tick boxes when `multiple`, otherwise one choice. At least `min` must be picked. The terminal numbers the options and reads the numbers.

**Answered with:** `chosen`, with the `id` of each option picked. `back` goes back.

```json
{
  "step": "choose",
  "title": "Which blinds?",
  "text": "Tick the blinds to add.",
  "options": [
    {
      "id": "blind-1",
      "label": "Blind 1",
      "detail": "192.0.2.21",
      "selected": true
    },
    {
      "id": "blind-2",
      "label": "Blind 2",
      "detail": "192.0.2.22",
      "selected": false
    }
  ],
  "multiple": true,
  "min": 1
}
```

### external

`SetupStep::External`. Do something elsewhere first (create an API token, enable developer mode), then come back with values.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | The step's heading. |
| `text` | `String` | What to do, in a sentence or two. |
| `link` | `Option<String>` | Where to do it, when there is a page for it. |
| `fields` | `Vec<Field>` | The fields to fill in afterwards. |

**Drawn:** The title and the text, with `link` as a button that opens in a new tab (the terminal prints it), then the fields as in `form`.

**Answered with:** `values`, as for `form`.

```json
{
  "step": "external",
  "title": "Create an access token",
  "text": "Open the vendor's developer page, create a token with read and control rights, and paste it here.",
  "link": "https://developer.example.org/tokens",
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "token",
      "label": "Access token",
      "help": "The token you created.",
      "kind": {
        "type": "secret"
      },
      "required": true,
      "value": null
    }
  ]
}
```

### done

`SetupStep::Done`. Finished. The hub validates and stores the result.

**Drawn:** Only `summary`. The hub validates `config` with the plugin, stores it, the secrets and the devices to adopt, in one transaction, and audits the slot names, never a value. The config and the secrets never reach the app or the terminal.

**Answered with:** Nothing. The flow is over.

```json
{
  "step": "done",
  "config": {
    "address": "192.0.2.20",
    "port": 8080
  },
  "adopt": [
    {
      "local_id": "blind-1",
      "target_hint": null,
      "class": "other",
      "name": "Blind 1",
      "capabilities": [
        {
          "cap": "custom",
          "action": "acme-blinds.calibrate"
        }
      ],
      "attrs": {
        "address": "192.0.2.21"
      }
    }
  ],
  "summary": "Paired. 1 blind added."
}
```

### failed

`SetupStep::Failed`. It did not work. `retry` offers the previous step again.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | `String` | Why, as one sentence. |
| `retry` | `bool` | Whether the previous step can be tried again. |

**Drawn:** `reason`, with a button to try the previous step again when `retry` is true.

**Answered with:** When `retry` is true, the input of the previous step again. Otherwise nothing.

```json
{
  "step": "failed",
  "reason": "Pairing needs a hub in live mode. Run `swifty go-live`, then set this up again.",
  "retry": false
}
```

## `Field`

One field of a form.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `String` | The key its value is sent back under. |
| `label` | `String` | The field's label. |
| `help` | `String` | One sentence for the person filling it in. |
| `kind` | `FieldType` | What it may hold. |
| `required` | `bool` | Whether it must be filled in. |
| `value` | `Option<Scalar>` | A prefill. Never set for a secret. |

## `FieldType`

What a form field may hold.

| Type | Meaning | Drawn as | Comes back as | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | Text. | A one-line text box of at most `max_len` characters. | text | `{"type":"text","max_len":64}` |
| `host` | IP address or host name. | A text box for an IP address or a host name. | text | `{"type":"host"}` |
| `url` | A URL. | A text box for a URL. | text | `{"type":"url"}` |
| `host_port` | A host and a port. | A text box for `host:port`. | text | `{"type":"host_port"}` |
| `port` | A port. | A number box from 1 to 65535. | int (the terminal may send text; accept both) | `{"type":"port"}` |
| `int` | A whole number in a range. | A number box from `min` to `max`. | int (the terminal may send text; accept both) | `{"type":"int","min":1,"max":3600}` |
| `bool` | `true` or `false`. | A tick box. The terminal asks yes or no. | bool | `{"type":"bool"}` |
| `choice` | One of these words. | A list to pick one of `options` from. | text, one of the options | `{"type":"choice","options":["eu","us"]}` |
| `mac` | A MAC address. | A text box for a MAC address such as `aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff`. | text | `{"type":"mac"}` |
| `secret` | Masked on screen, sent once, never echoed, logged or audited. | A masked box, never prefilled. The value is sent once, and never echoed, logged or audited. | text | `{"type":"secret"}` |
| `multiline` | A longer paste, such as a CA certificate in PEM. | A box for a longer paste of at most `max_len` characters, such as a CA certificate. | text | `{"type":"multiline","max_len":8192}` |

Read a value from `SetupInput::Values` by its key, and accept what a person may type: trim text, and take a number either as `Int` or as `Text` holding digits. A required field can still arrive empty; answer with the form again or `failed` with `retry: true`, never a panic.

## `Choice`

One thing that can be picked in a `Choose` step.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `String` | What is sent back when it is picked. |
| `label` | `String` | Its name. |
| `detail` | `String` | One line more about it, such as its address. |
| `selected` | `bool` | Whether it starts picked. |

## `SetupInput`

What the person sent back for a step.

| Input | Meaning | JSON |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | The values of a form, by key. | `{"input":"values","values":{"address":"192.0.2.20","port":8080}}` |
| `chosen` | What was picked in a `Choose` step. | `{"input":"chosen","ids":["blind-1"]}` |
| `poll` | The hub asking a `Wait` step whether it is done. | `{"input":"poll"}` |
| `back` | Go back one step. | `{"input":"back"}` |

## `SetupResult`

What a finished setup hands to the hub. `Debug` redacts `secrets`.

| Field | Type | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `config` | `Value` | The instance config. Must pass `Plugin::validate`. No secrets in it. |
| `secrets` | `Vec<(String, Secret)>` | Slot and value. Stored by the hub, nowhere else. |
| `adopt` | `Vec<DeviceDecl>` | Devices to adopt at once (the lights that were ticked). |
| `summary` | `String` | One line for the person: "Paired. 6 lights added." |

`secrets` is never serialised: the `done` step's JSON above has no secret in it, and its `Debug` prints `<redacted>` for each value. A slot you return must be declared in the manifest (`name`, or `name/<key>` for a `name/{key}` slot). Leave a slot out to keep the value the hub already holds: a flow never sees a stored value, only `SetupContext::secrets_present`.
